sections.content:
You know the commands from Units 23 and 24. The golden rule of Spanish command pronouns:
1. Affirmative commands: Pronouns ATTACH to the end of the verb as one single word.
2. Negative commands: Pronouns go BEFORE the verb as separate words.

items.english: Sit down here and listen to me!

items.spanish: ¡No te sientes en el suelo mojado!
items.english: Don't sit on the wet ground!

items.spanish: Si tienes una pregunta, hazla ahora.
items.english: If you have a question, ask it now.

sections.content: Accent Mark Rule: When attaching pronouns adds syllables and moves stress beyond the penultimate syllable, add a written accent to preserve the original vowel stress: compra → cómpralo; di → dime.
